name: Turfanosuchus
sum: Turfanosuchus is a likely gracilisuchid pseudosuchian from the Middle Triassic of north-western China whose classification has been difficult.
wsnote: No body-length estimate is given in the sources consulted.
holotype: IVPP V.32237, a partially complete but disarticulated skeleton from the Kelamayi Formation, Turfan Basin.
material: The holotype, redescribed by Wu and Russell (2001).
biology: Curved, finely serrated teeth (probably five in the premaxilla and at least 13 in the maxilla) suggest a carnivore; the sources consulted give no further evidence of habits.
author: Young 1973

images.artist: Richard J. Butler, Corwin Sullivan, Martín D. Ezcurra, Jun Liu, Agustina Lecuona and Roland B. Sookias
images.caption: Skull views of Turfanosuchus.
